name: Chapter 1: Sets
description: Sets, roster and set-builder forms, subsets, intervals, Venn diagrams, union, intersection, complement and De Morgan’s laws.

name: Chapter 2: Relations and Functions
description: Cartesian products, relations, domain and range, functions, standard graphs, modulus, signum and greatest integer, algebra of functions.

name: Chapter 3: Trigonometric Functions
description: Radians, signs and values, domain and range, compound, multiple and sum-product formulas

name: Chapter 4: Complex Numbers and Quadratic Equations
description: Complex numbers, algebra, powers of i, modulus and conjugate, Argand plane, polar form, roots of unity and quadratic equations.

name: Chapter 5: Linear Inequalities
description: Inequalities, rules for solving, number-line graphs, double inequalities, systems, word problems, modulus and quadratic inequalities, half-planes.

name: Chapter 6: Permutations and Combinations
description: Counting principles, factorials, permutations with and without repetition, combinations, words, digits, committees, cards and exam techniques.
